title: Mridul Tiwari Donates Bigg Boss 19 Earnings To Education: 'Pure Heart' | Television News - News18
text: Mridul Tiwari may not have walked away with the Bigg Boss 19 trophy, but his actions after stepping out of the house have firmly established him as one of the most admired contestants of the season. As one of the youngest participants on the reality show, Mridul left a lasting impression not only through his gameplay but also through the values he stood for long before the finale. Even before entering the Bigg Boss house, Mridul had made a bold and heartfelt promise. He publicly stated that if he emerged as the winner, he would donate the entire Bigg Boss fee of Rs 50 lakh towards public welfare, particularly focusing on education. Though fate had different plans, his commitment to social responsibility has remained unwavering. Post-Bigg Boss 19: Mridul’s NGO Visits Go Viral In the days following his eviction, Mridul was seen visiting multiple NGOs that support physically challenged individuals and underprivileged children. During these visits, he spent quality time interacting with the children, listening to their stories and understanding their challenges. His genuine involvement struck a chord with many, as photos and videos from these visits quickly circulated across social media platforms. Mridul Tiwari’s Emotional Reflection on Education What truly resonated with fans was Mridul’s deeply personal note shared alongside his NGO visits. In a heartfelt post, he wrote, “I wasn’t able to get much formal education, but I still try to improve and educate myself every day. Education is more important than anything." The statement offered a glimpse into his life journey and explained why education remains such a core cause for him. Fans Applaud Mridul Tiwari’s Efforts The internet was quick to shower Mridul with appreciation. His well-wishers flooded the comment section with messages of love and admiration. One user wrote, “The way you share happiness is beautiful, keep inspiring," while another simply commented, “Pure heart." Bigg Boss 19 Earnings to Support Education and Welfare According to sources close to the influencer and content creator, a substantial portion of Mridul’s earnings from Bigg Boss 19, including appearance fees and associated income, is being directed toward educational initiatives and welfare programmes. Mridul Tiwari Speaks About His Mission In an interview with The Times of India, Mridul opened up about his motivation, saying, “While growing up, I understood how important education is, but I never got the chance to receive proper formal schooling. That’s something I try to change by constantly learning something new. I make every effort to educate myself. I had also decided that if I won Bigg Boss, I would donate the prize money for education. Even now, I will do whatever I can and whatever is within my reach to help educate these children. Those who are deprived of education truly understand its value." Bigg Boss 19 Eviction: How Mridul’s Journey Ended Mridul Tiwari’s Bigg Boss journey came to an end during a mid-week eviction episode. The house witnessed a unique captaincy task involving a live audience, who voted via secret ballot after contestants pitched for themselves. Gaurav Khanna and Shehbaz Badesha emerged as the top contenders, while Mridul received the least votes and was asked to leave the house immediately. Although Mridul did not take home the trophy or the cash prize, his compassion, integrity and dedication to social causes have earned him something far more meaningful—the love and respect of the audience.
